historical_controls.name: positive/read
historical_controls.obligation: Read response/payload conservation

historical_controls.name: positive/write_mask
historical_controls.obligation: Write payload and byte enables

historical_controls.name: positive/slave_error
historical_controls.obligation: Slave ERR propagation, not a successful read

historical_controls.name: positive/unmapped
historical_controls.obligation: Documented unmapped-address error without slave request

historical_controls.name: positive/concurrent
historical_controls.obligation: Two different destinations and response owners

historical_controls.name: positive/pipeline
historical_controls.obligation: Consecutive accepts, slave accept/response overlap, ACK while STB is low

historical_controls.name: positive/accept_and_return
historical_controls.obligation: Master acceptance and earlier response on the same edge

historical_controls.name: positive/master1
historical_controls.obligation: Upper public packed port slices

historical_controls.name: positive/reset_then_new
historical_controls.obligation: New transaction after completed work and synchronous reset

historical_controls.name: positive/reset_inflight
historical_controls.obligation: Reset cancels outstanding work; new epoch completes independently

historical_controls.name: negative/read_data
historical_controls.obligation: Wrong returned read data

historical_controls.name: negative/write_data
historical_controls.obligation: Wrong forwarded write payload

historical_controls.name: negative/write_mask
historical_controls.obligation: Wrong forwarded byte mask

historical_controls.name: negative/address
historical_controls.obligation: Wrong forwarded address

historical_controls.name: negative/direction
historical_controls.obligation: Read changed to write

historical_controls.name: negative/missing_forward
historical_controls.obligation: Fabricated master completion without forwarding or slave response

historical_controls.name: negative/wrong_owner
historical_controls.obligation: Response delivered to wrong master

historical_controls.name: negative/duplicate_response
historical_controls.obligation: No response without outstanding accepted work

historical_controls.name: negative/error_as_success
historical_controls.obligation: Slave error cannot become success

historical_controls.name: negative/stale_after_reset
historical_controls.obligation: Stale response in a reset-cleared epoch

historical_controls.name: negative/stale_into_new_epoch
historical_controls.obligation: Premature completion of new accepted work before forwarding/response, after reset

historical_controls.name: negative/early_unexplained_error
historical_controls.obligation: Mapped request fails one cycle after first activity without slave ERR or elapsed OPT_TIMEOUT=16; requires independent review of timeout applicability

historical_controls.name: incomplete/missing_return
historical_controls.obligation: No complete/scoped pass with unretired work; no invented liveness deadline

historical_controls.name: incomplete/truncated
historical_controls.obligation: Pending response at end must remain explicit

historical_controls.name: invalid/master_changes_stalled_payload
historical_controls.obligation: Changing stalled request is an external assumption violation

historical_controls.name: positive/masked_write_bytes
historical_controls.obligation: Disabled write byte lanes are not specified data

historical_controls.name: positive/slave_stall
historical_controls.obligation: Held slave request through backpressure

historical_controls.name: negative/slave_stalled_payload
historical_controls.obligation: DUT must hold stalled request

historical_controls.name: negative/slave_stalled_strobe
historical_controls.obligation: DUT cannot withdraw a stalled request without abort

historical_controls.name: negative/ack_and_err
historical_controls.obligation: ACK and ERR cannot both terminate the same request

historical_controls.name: negative/reset_slave_cycle
historical_controls.obligation: Slave-side CYC must be reset on the sampling edge

historical_controls.name: unresolved/identical_heads
historical_controls.obligation: Identical concurrent candidates cannot be assigned by guesswork

historical_controls.name: positive/contention
historical_controls.obligation: Same destination, distinguishable write requests and in-order ownership

historical_controls.name: positive/mapped_decode_restart
historical_controls.obligation: Decode error behind a mapped response then fresh mapped work

historical_controls.name: positive/slave_error_burst_restart
historical_controls.obligation: Slave error terminates a pipelined cycle; restart has no stale completion

historical_controls.name: positive/abort_late_slave_restart
historical_controls.obligation: Late slave ACK while old slave CYC remains high cannot retire new master work

historical_controls.name: unresolved/unclassified_late_error
historical_controls.obligation: Without a proved timeout origin, ERR must not become scoped_pass or a successful recovery event

historical_controls.name: incomplete/both_interfaces_pending
historical_controls.obligation: Master and slave accepted work both pending at batch end

historical_controls.name: unresolved/post_abort_forward
historical_controls.obligation: Matching accepted-but-unforwarded old write appears after abort; attribution unresolved, no completion credit

historical_controls.name: unresolved/late_post_abort_forward
historical_controls.obligation: Same identity later after abort; no invented undocumented timing cutoff; cannot be scoped_pass

historical_controls.name: negative/post_abort_corrupt_data
historical_controls.obligation: Even at abort boundary, changed enabled write lane must not match accepted work

historical_controls.name: negative/post_abort_unaccepted_address
historical_controls.obligation: No matching accepted address; abort is not permission for arbitrary new transactions

historical_controls.name: negative/duplicate_aborted_forward
historical_controls.obligation: An aborted identity can justify at most one downstream acceptance; duplicate must fail, despite unresolved timing baseline

historical_controls.name: unresolved/post_abort_then_reset
historical_controls.obligation: A later reset clears old identities but cannot erase the earlier unresolved post-abort observation

historical_controls.name: negative/reset_clears_aborted_identity
historical_controls.obligation: Pre-reset accepted work cannot justify a post-reset downstream request

historical_controls.name: unresolved/live_aborted_ambiguity
historical_controls.obligation: Indistinguishable live and aborted owners require unresolved attribution, not guessed ownership or completion

new_controls.name: multi_abort/m0_s0_later_identity
new_controls.basis: CYC withdrawal invalidates outstanding completion. Public authority does not settle partial cancellation or propagation latency; matching residual work must not be called proven invented work.

new_controls.name: multi_abort/m0_s1_later_identity
new_controls.basis: CYC withdrawal invalidates outstanding completion. Public authority does not settle partial cancellation or propagation latency; matching residual work must not be called proven invented work.

new_controls.name: multi_abort/m1_s0_later_identity
new_controls.basis: CYC withdrawal invalidates outstanding completion. Public authority does not settle partial cancellation or propagation latency; matching residual work must not be called proven invented work.

new_controls.name: multi_abort/m1_s1_later_identity
new_controls.basis: CYC withdrawal invalidates outstanding completion. Public authority does not settle partial cancellation or propagation latency; matching residual work must not be called proven invented work.

new_controls.name: multi_abort/third_identity
new_controls.basis: Multiple older accepted requests may remain unobserved; do not assume all survive cancellation.

new_controls.name: multi_abort/late_identity
new_controls.basis: No new fixed grace period or latency assumption may be invented.

new_controls.name: multi_abort/disabled_byte_change
new_controls.basis: A disabled write-byte change does not establish corruption.

new_controls.name: multi_abort/sel_zero
new_controls.basis: SEL zero does not supply data evidence but retains address/direction/SEL identity.

new_controls.name: fault/aborted_address
new_controls.basis: No accepted live or aborted request has this active identity; unresolved abort timing does not forgive corruption.

new_controls.name: fault/aborted_enabled_byte
new_controls.basis: No accepted live or aborted request has this active identity; unresolved abort timing does not forgive corruption.

new_controls.name: fault/aborted_direction
new_controls.basis: No accepted live or aborted request has this active identity; unresolved abort timing does not forgive corruption.

new_controls.name: fault/aborted_select
new_controls.basis: No accepted live or aborted request has this active identity; unresolved abort timing does not forgive corruption.

new_controls.name: fault/duplicate_consumed_identity
new_controls.basis: An accepted identity cannot justify two downstream accepts.

new_controls.name: fault/reset_then_old_forward
new_controls.basis: Reset removes old request identity; it cannot explain post-reset work.

new_controls.name: multi_abort/reset_preserves_prior_uncertainty
new_controls.basis: Reset clears current identities but cannot erase already observed uncertainty.

new_controls.name: multi_abort/live_aborted_same_identity
new_controls.basis: Indistinguishable old and live owners cannot be assigned by guesswork.

new_controls.name: multi_abort/identical_aborted_requests
new_controls.basis: Multiplicity must not be silently collapsed or reused.

new_controls.name: positive/cancel_all_then_fresh
new_controls.basis: Canceled work is never completed; new distinct work has matching downstream ACK.

new_controls.name: fault/stale_ack_into_fresh
new_controls.basis: New request cannot complete before its slave acceptance/response.

new_controls.name: positive/live_fifo_order
new_controls.basis: Two distinguishable non-aborted requests forwarded and retired in order.

new_controls.name: fault/live_order_swap
new_controls.basis: Unaborted ordered traffic must retain existing order checks; cancellation uncertainty cannot be generalized.

new_controls.name: multi_abort/accept_same_edge_err
new_controls.basis: Pre-edge acceptance and error retirement are distinct; later matching buffered work has unsettled abort status.

new_controls.name: fault/retired_error_identity_reused
new_controls.basis: Already forwarded and ERR-retired work cannot be recycled as unforwarded aborted work.

classification_note: Expectations are integration-role proposed controls, not a new normative specification. Claude independently challenges their validity. Unresolved-baseline fault detection is separate from clean-baseline mutation sensitivity.
